snapshot_label: Continuous question WER and context-aware response quality

Implement shared S1 answer extraction, scoring and token accounting.
tasks.evidence: Evaluator v0.1.2 passes 46 CPU checks; original 43-check snapshot and three historical examples are retained separately.

tasks.text: Implement run-time progress updates from the same saved records as the checklists.
tasks.evidence: Native GPU-job phase/case updates and 30-second heartbeat are connected; public checkpoints use actual Slurm status and saved output records.

tasks.text: Check evaluator behavior on saved real outputs and labeled failure fixtures.
tasks.evidence: Three earlier real outputs and 43 CPU checks pass.

tasks.text: Run and inspect a small end-to-end DuplexOmni S1 pilot, including an early and a later request.
tasks.evidence: Three real meeting requests tested on one A100 80 GB; raw outputs, recorded speech and source facts reviewed. Full protocol remains unvalidated.

tasks.text: Publish an actual pilot output with its request, answer facts, score and explanation.
tasks.evidence: Actual input excerpts, S1 response audio, source facts, raw text and score explanations are published together.

tasks.text: Diagnose and repair empty or unusable S1 responses before full evaluation.
tasks.evidence: The revised sweep has 120/123 completed responses and 3 generation failures; source review finds 0/33 complete eligible answers. Native long-history recognition and full-bank validity remain unresolved.

tasks.text: Run both listening methods and inspect their meeting answers against source facts.
tasks.evidence: Two native listening methods: 4/4 meeting outputs saved and 4/4 source reviews recorded; full protocol remains unvalidated. Neither method gives a complete meeting answer; recognition remains unresolved.

tasks.text: Reproduce the working DailyTalk recipe and compare it with the current S1 runner.
tasks.evidence: The original helper and new native runner match all 40 response-field records; their spoken discount/full-price answers agree. P01 request-only recognition passes (WER 0.063), while its folder-status answer is unsupported without earlier evidence.

tasks.text: Review the original-input P01 sweep with every sentence-based increase in earlier context.
tasks.evidence: 41/41 contexts reviewed for one question; 20 preserve question meaning in ASR, and 0/11 eligible contexts give complete reference answers within 19.2 s.

tasks.text: Review the original-input microphone comparison across 41 histories and its spoken-response content.
tasks.evidence: Three signals at 41 lengths: 78 new native replays, 3 generation failures shown as gaps, 33 eligible spoken answers scored by a qualified local judge and audited against the source; 0 complete. One question; full protocol remains unvalidated.

tasks.text: Apply the acoustic revision to every recorded primary question and published voice alternative.
tasks.evidence: All 105 primary questions plus six voice alternatives revised; 111 source-PCM/timing checks and empty background-ASR controls. Seven paired-ASR caveats remain visible; no human naturalness claim.

tasks.text: Rerun all microphone/context positions with revised inputs and inspect actual spoken answers.
tasks.evidence: 123 positions freshly attempted, 120 completed responses, 3 generation failures shown as gaps; qualified local judge and source review cover 33 eligible answers, 0 complete.

tasks.text: Rerun the earlier eligible pilot controls and retain the long-prefix capacity exclusion.
tasks.evidence: Both native listening methods attempted P01/P02; 0/4 source-reviewed answers complete. P03 remains excluded by the unchanged full-prefix context limit.

tasks.text: Evaluate saved spoken responses using context, question and reference with separate quality dimensions.
tasks.evidence: Local Qwen3 judge: 120/120 ratings passing output/citation checks, anchored relevance/support/adequacy, qualification and 12 prompt-order probes; no new S1 speech. Full-bank evaluator validation remains pending.

tasks.text: Qualify native S1 history and automatic judging, then freeze the evaluation protocol before broader experiments.
tasks.evidence: The one-question microphone sweep is reviewed and the revised local judge passed twelve authored checks; validate all 105 references, qualify judging on distinct questions and check the other S1 callers before full-bank evaluation.

tasks.text: Generate or repair and validate all 105 reference answers.
Check every S1 caller and evaluate all 105 questions for each S1 model.
Select chunks and thinking goals on separate development meetings.
Run the remaining text and speech S2 conditions on all 105 questions.
